text:
Maria (People Ops): Heads-up — Alex's onboarding day is next Tuesday. Small wrinkle: their passport expired but they have a Permanent Resident Card. Is that OK for I-9 List A? Also want to confirm a day-1 drop-in window for badge + laptop pickup.

Alex Chen: Yep I have the PR card and a current driver's license. Can do 9:30–10:30. Thanks!

Samir Patel: PR card is valid List A. We just need original physical card at the I-9 check. No copies.

Maria (People Ops): Great, Samir — can you confirm we have an I-9-qualified verifier available that slot? If not, we'll use the remote verification flow.

Jordan Lee: I can meet at 9:45 at lobby A. I’ll escort and take them to the badge station. Reserving desk 3B for laptop handoff.

IT Support Bot: provisioning request received: new hire alex.chen@redwood.com — laptop image: rdw-standard-2026, MDM enroll pending. ETA 24 hours.

Maria (People Ops): Thanks Jordan and IT bot. Alex — please bring one of the following original documents to the I-9 office (physical only):

```
List A: U.S. Passport (current) OR Permanent Resident Card (Form I-551)
OR
List B + List C: Driver's license + Social Security card / birth certificate
```

Alex Chen: Got it — I’ll bring the PR card + DL. Quick question: can I drop the I-9 and badge at 9:30 and do benefits paperwork later in the day?

Maria (People Ops): Yes — benefits orientation is at 2pm in conference Beta. We'll add you to the calendar. For I-9, if anything looks off Samir will flag and we may use a secondary verifier flow.

Samir Patel: FYI background check status looks clear — BackgroundCheckBot shows "clear - no flags".

BackgroundCheckBot: Background check completed for Alex Chen (candidate ID 8421) — RESULT: Clear.

Jordan Lee: Escort confirmed. I'll meet Alex at lobby A, then walk to facilities for badge photo.

Maria (People Ops): All set. I'll send a calendar invite to Alex with: 9:30–10:30 badge/I-9 drop-in (Lobby A -> 3B), 2:00–3:00 benefits orientation (Conf Beta). Alex, reply here if you need a different slot. :smile:

Alex Chen: That works, thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Maria (People Ops): One last note — if Alex needs to use alternative ID verification because of a travel delay, we have a documented exception process (requires ID verification video + manager attestation). Ping me and Samir to start that.

Samir Patel: Copy. If exception needed, please include photo of PR card front/back and manager email attesting identity.

IT Support Bot: Laptop imaging scheduled. MDM invite will be sent to alex.chen@redwood.com at provisioning completion.

Maria (People Ops): Closing loop — Jordan, please confirm when escort is complete so I can mark onboarding checklist done. Thanks team!
